keywords_en: a survey of unknown unknowns in post-quantum algorithms
summary_en: fede_intern asked whether any multisig is formally verified for EIP-7702 and sought collaborators. zooko recommended Sophie Schmieg's survey of unknown unknowns in post-quantum algorithms, concluding stateless hash based signatures are safest. About $7M drained via the Trust Wallet browser extension drew discussion.
